info.title: EGI Media AI Backend API
info.description: API contract for the EGI Media AI decision-support service. The service is tenant- and company-scoped, reads editorial articles from egi-media-backend, and exposes only validated AI projections. It never exposes prompts, provider credentials, raw provider output, or CMS write operations.

get.description: Returns the newest Company Context snapshots first. One version is effective; earlier approved versions remain archived for audit and review.

post.summary: Upload a company profile PDF and request a Company Context draft
post.description: Validates and extracts one bounded PDF in memory, then sends only sanitized extracted text to T01 Mini. The result is always a non-effective draft.

Approve a reviewed Company Context draft
post.description: Only this human-approved action creates an effective Company Context version for downstream T02 use.

200.description: Draft approved and effective context version created

post.summary: Start a scoped ingest or backfill run
post.description: Internal-only. Does not accept article content from callers. `poll`/`article` read the editorial CMS; `crawl-poll` reads the crawl store read-only for one registered `crawl_source_id` since its watermark. Published/source validation runs before any snapshot is created. Requires `ai.pipeline.run`. Human Settings should use `/api/v1/news-intake/pull` instead.

get.description: Business-facing status for Automatic intake (process-wide CMS poll scheduler) and workers that process Pull articles now. Requires `news.intake.read` and trusted tenant/company scope. Does not expose internal pipeline task routes.

Company-scoped Recent runs for News intake (ingest-family jobs: cms.poll, crawl.poll, cms.article.trigger). Newest-first, bounded pagination via `limit` (default 20, max 100) plus `offset` or opaque `cursor` (mutually exclusive). Optional `status` filter. Unrelated AI-task jobs are excluded unless `include_ai_tasks=true` (then labeled `family=ai_task`). Does not dump the full queue. Requires `news.intake.read` and trusted scope.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by job state; invalid values return 400

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset; mutually exclusive with cursor

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior `next_cursor`; mutually exclusive with offset

parameters.name: include_ai_tasks
parameters.description: When true, include non-intake company jobs labeled family=ai_task

post.description: Manual News intake trigger. Modes: poll (EGI Media CMS), crawl-poll (one registered media), article (one article id). Reuses the ingest worker queue. Does not accept article content from callers. Requires `news.intake.trigger`, Idempotency-Key, and trusted scope. Does not grant or require full `ai.pipeline.run`.

Enable or disable process-wide Automatic intake (CMS poll scheduler only). Idempotent start/stop of the scheduler; does not stop workers so Pull articles now still works. Requires `news.intake.manage`. Does not grant `ai.pipeline.run`. `AI_SCHEDULER_CATCH_UP` is dead config and is not exposed here.

post.summary: Replay a selected pipeline stage from a recorded input version
post.description: Internal/operator-only. Replay creates a new run and never overwrites historical stage output in place. Scope, source version, and idempotency are revalidated.

get.description: Accepts a CMS article UUID, `cms:<uuid>`, or `crawl:<source_id>:<content_hash>`. Crawl sources are read-only and cite the original media URL.

200.description: Published source article and locale-aware citation

get.summary: Read a published CMS article through the source gate
get.description: Read-only source lookup. CMS ids (`<uuid>` or `cms:<uuid>`) resolve through the CMS gate; `crawl:<source_id>:<content_hash>` resolves read-only from the crawl store and cites the original media URL. Viral references are rejected. Unpublished, deleted, malformed, or unsupported-locale articles are rejected.

200.description: Published source article and locale-aware citation

post.description: Runs Nano for one published article and one effective Company Context. `none` is persisted and stops downstream issue formation.
Runs Nano for an existing T02 decision. The T02 relevance label is immutable and cannot be changed by T03.

200.description: T03 rationale and immutable T02 decision

post.description: Creates a company-scoped issue for new or attaches a development for update. A selesai issue is never silently reopened.
Analyzes all linked, published, fresh article evidence for one active issue.
Labels every existing T07 claim exactly once; it cannot add or rewrite claims.
Revalidates fresh canonical evidence, citations, and T08 labels before replacing the current analysis.
Produces only tinggi, sedang, or rendah for a current citation-gated analysis. It does not select Top 5.
Produces a grounded reason for the immutable T09 decision. It does not rank or select Top 5.

put.description: Stores recipient preference used by backend alert eligibility rules. It does not send email.

post.description: Rules-only decision for preference, priority, dedupe, and quiet hours. Material update with no product decision is fail-closed as suppressed. This endpoint never sends email and never exposes recipient or subject selection to an AI model.

post.summary: Create a daily, weekly, or monthly report draft
post.description: Creates a backend-owned report draft from a period-consistent metric set and validated issue/insight pack. The input excludes raw article bodies and does not use the dashboard Top 5 as an implicit cap.

post.summary: Constrained rewrite of one report span
post.description: Human-only T14 rewrite. The caller selects exactly one cited span and supplies one bounded instruction. Backend preserves the existing citation set and checks the narrative version before applying the replacement.
Runs T13 Mini only on the backend-created draft's validated issue and insight pack. It cannot select issues, calculate metrics, approve, share, or send the report.

Runs Nano only after the backend has produced an eligible direct alert event. The model receives validated issue evidence and claim references, never recipient, subject, email address, or delivery instructions. This endpoint generates content only and never sends email.

Uses the backend Gmail SMTP adapter with a backend-rendered template. Recipient and subject are read from backend persistence/template logic; request and model output cannot override them. Delivery is deduplicated by alert event, retried for retryable provider failures, and audited.
